name: affiliate-product-verification
description: §18.3 Product Verification: §6 fact/source rules → VERIFIED | NEEDS_REVIEW | REJECTED.

nodes.name: verify-products
nodes.notes: §6 verification: requires name, valid sourceUrl, ≥2 sourced facts. Unsourced claims → NEEDS_REVIEW; insufficient research → REJECTED. Never invents specifications.

nodes.name: split-verdict
nodes.notes: Per-item routing: VERIFIED continues; others go to review/reject.

nodes.name: trigger-script
nodes.notes: Forwards VERIFIED products to script generation (§18.5).

nodes.name: check-review
nodes.notes: NEEDS_REVIEW → park for human. Otherwise REJECTED.
